title: Payment Extension Allowances and Fees — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier Table
content:
The tiers of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract differ in how readily installments may be deferred by an extension. The table gives every tier's figures.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Installments satisfied before an extension (minimum) | 12 | 9 | 9 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Days past due at which an extension may still be granted (maximum) | 45 | 45 | 59 | 59 | 59 | 59 |
| Installments one extension may defer (maximum) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Installments deferred over the life of the contract (maximum) | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 4 | 4 |
| Extension fee where the contract's state permits one (USD) | 35.00 | 35.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Good-faith payment before an extension, percent of the monthly payment | 50 | 25 | 25 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Calendar months between two extensions (minimum) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| No extension when this many or fewer installments remain | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Calendar days to complete a signed extension agreement before it expires | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Notes

- A good-faith percentage of 0, as on Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+, means no good-faith payment is required.
- An extension fee of 0.00, as on Tier 1 and Tier 1+, means no fee is charged on those tiers.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a Tier 4 contract with a monthly payment of USD 600.00, a good-faith payment of 25 percent is USD 150.00.
